plates.title: Current design (2025)
plates.fact: Tamaulipas's 2025 plate is white with a sweeping guinda-red and gold band along the bottom, 'Tamaulipas México' up top, a QR code in the corner and the national and state coats of arms.

notes: The image is the government's own plate artwork (1200x691, ratio 1.74), showing an 'AAA-000-A' 'Transporte privado nacional - Automóvil' plate. Replating was mandatory statewide from January 2, 2025, replacing the previous administration's blue plates (per Vanguardia). I found no deadline for when the blue plates stop being valid. The tamaulipas.gob.mx article page loads very slowly. I saw no World Cup, eco or classic-car designs.
